recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Further edits would be redundant unless a new work-group decision narrows or expands the mapping-language conversion rules beyond the already-applied FHIR-22774 resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-22774 is a Published FHIR-core/StructureMap change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking the mapping-language specification to state that underlying type systems MAY define required implicit conversions and to link to the FHIRPath implicit type conversion material as an example.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 14a82a5234ca1bd192c12874f6877867eca73bb4, which added the Type Wrangling section to source/mapping-language.html and linked it to the FHIRPath type-conversion section. The current source still contains that section and link.
additional_context: The mapping-language page is in the current build navigation under Implementation Support and is linked from the StructureMap introduction, so the authoritative page requested by the issue is in scope. FHIR-I minutes from 2019-08-19 record the 10-0-0 decision to cross-reference the FHIRPath casting behavior from a new mapping-language section, and the Zulip thread confirms the concern was model-defined implicit conversions between system primitives and target-model primitive types. A Jira term search found no later final issue in this same area that changes the requested wording.
reconciliation: No source changes were made because source/mapping-language.html already states that source and target type systems MAY define required implicit conversions, explains the primitive/string handling context, and links to fhirpath.html#types exactly as the resolution required.
